title: AI Motion Graphics Generator — Editable Animations | Kario
excerpt: Create motion graphics with AI from a brief, logo, images, or product URL. Edit every layer, request changes in plain English, and export to MP4.
content_html:
kario

AI motion graphics generator

Create motion graphics with AI.
Edit every layer.

Describe your video and add your logo, images, or product URL. Kario turns your brief into an animated video with editable layers. Ask for changes in plain English or fine-tune them yourself, then export to MP4.

No credit card required

How it works

From a brief to editable motion graphics

Kario handles the animation work end to end, then hands you a project you can still touch — so a change doesn't mean starting over.

01

Brief it

Describe the video and hand over your logo, product shots, or a URL. Kario reads the brief the way a designer would.

02

It builds

Kario lays out the scenes, picks the type, and animates every layer — a real project you can still edit, not a locked video file.

03

Direct it

Ask for changes in plain language, or open any layer in the editor and move it yourself.

04

Or direct it from your own AI

Connect Claude or ChatGPT over MCP and Kario builds, remixes, and shares videos straight from chat.

For agencies and platforms. Unlimited credits, API access, custom branded templates, dedicated support, and an SLA.

Talk to us

Credits pay for the agent's work: planning, writing, animating, and voiceover. Rendering and exporting never cost credits, on any plan. Top up any time at $1 for 10 credits.

Questions

What does Kario actually produce?
A real motion graphics project: text, shapes, images, video, and audio as separate layers with keyframes. Kario renders it to MP4, but the project stays a project, not a flattened clip.

Can I edit what it makes?
Yes. Every project opens in the editor with its layers, keyframes, and timeline intact. Change anything by hand, or ask Kario for the change in plain language.

Do I need to know motion design?
No. Brief Kario the way you would brief a designer. If you do know the craft, the editor gives you the same layers a designer would have built.

What formats and sizes does it export?
MP4, in landscape or vertical. The examples on this site are all direct exports.

How do credits work?
Credits pay for the agent's work: planning, writing, animating, and voiceover. Rendering and exporting to MP4 never use credits. Every plan includes a monthly allowance, and you can top up any time at $1 for 10 credits.

Can I use it from Claude or ChatGPT?
Yes. Connect Kario over MCP and build, remix, and share videos straight from chat. Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and ChatGPT are all supported.

Is there a free plan?
Yes. Start free with no credit card, and upgrade when you need more credits.

Your first motion graphic in a minute

Brief Kario. It handles the animation, the brand, and the export.
